identity.description: HubSpot is a CRM and sales platform (HubSpot CRM, 'Smart CRM') that offers developer APIs, apps, and an MCP server. Developer docs live at developers.hubspot.com.
identity.identity_notes: developers.hubspot.com documents the HubSpot CRM APIs and account types. The assignment hint hubspot.com matches the product. The official website was not fetched; the sandbox page at www.hubspot.com appeared in search results.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0-based app auth for multi-customer apps and Marketplace listings; the hosted MCP server requires OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
auth.token_refresh: Private app tokens can be rotated; rotating issues a new token and expires the old one (from search excerpt of the auth docs, not verbatim-verified).
auth.scopes_notes: Not verified. Scope configuration is noted on the webhooks guide (apps must be configured with scopes for each CRM object type) but was not fetched.

access.production_restrictions: Integrations for multi-customer use or Marketplace listing must be built as an app using OAuth. Legacy private apps can no longer be created as of October 26, 2026, and the new developer platform is the pointer for current apps.

resources: CRM objects (contacts used as the documented example)
read_ops: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/contacts (example in API overview; from summary, not verbatim)
api.rate_limits: Subscriptions API: 50 requests per second per app. Daily and burst limits vary by account subscription and are not verified here.
api.limitations: Write coverage and full CRM breadth not verified from fetched pages. Legacy private app creation closed on October 26, 2026. Node SDK confirmed; other language SDKs not confirmed.
